breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to fix the inconsistency. The ground truth resolves the issue by removing the incorrect instruction to use the arithmetic-mean area. The Agent, however, kept this incorrect instruction, stating: 'The arithmetic-mean area is used in place of A(x) and treated as exact for the axial-deformation calculation.' It then proceeds to solve the problem using this flawed method, which directly contradicts the correction made in the ground truth.
